dragHint: Drag or use arrow keys to move. Select to open statistics.
preview: {count} reports · {evaluated} evaluated for all macro labels
scopeChoice: City or total for all 14 cities
timeScope: Time range: all months in the selected dataset.
savedStatistics: You can read the saved statistics without using AI chat.
answerUnavailable: Live AI answers are unavailable. You can read the saved statistics below.
mixedScope: The 14-city total combines official narratives and Munich's accepted POLIZEIKARTE summaries.
title: Offences and other conduct in the reports
caption: Labels in the selected records
total: {count} selected records, including records without a precise location.
label: Reported conduct
formula: Content index = 100 × records supporting the label ÷ all selected records.
incomplete: Shares count the labels supported so far. A final index remains unavailable while any record for that label is uncertain or has not been evaluated.
overlap: One record can support several labels. Percentages need not add to 100%. Follow-up reports remain separate records and can describe the same incident.
basis: These figures describe the selected reports. They do not measure all crimes or a city's crime risk.
hate: Possible hate crime is a source-backed AI lead, not a police finding. The social-category table separates explicit police wording from leads based on report narratives.
summaryScope: These labels use the accepted POLIZEIKARTE summaries. They are not a review of complete official narratives.
unavailable: Label statistics are unavailable for this source version.
compositeFormula: The composite uses only the declared weights: sum(weight × content index) ÷ sum(weights).
